description: Add an after exception hook to the OpenTelemetry configuration that allows developers to customize exception handling behavior in OpenTelemetry traces. This hook should be triggered whenever an exception occurs during request processing, enabling custom logging, metric collection, or trace enrichment.
functional_requirements: Add an optional 'after_exception' callback parameter to the OpenTelemetry configuration class
Ensure the hook receives the exception instance and relevant context (request, response, etc.) as parameters
Integrate the hook into the existing exception handling flow within the OpenTelemetry middleware/plugin
